daily_load_assessment: ATL is currently 6.6 with CTL at 12.9, giving a positive TSB of +6.3. You are fully rested from a stress perspective, but your physiological readiness is constrained by recent inactivity. Zero acute fatigue allows for training load, but intensity must be managed carefully.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the past 21 days, you recorded only 71 total training load across 2 short running sessions (1.0 hour total). This severe drop in acute volume has caused significant detraining. Fatigue accumulation (ATL) is near zero, meaning adaptation rate has stalled and must be restarted systematically.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: The 180-day macro trend reveals strong mid-year volume (cycling performance rides up to 100+ km in summer), followed by a steep drop-off through autumn, collapsing CTL down to 12.9. Reaching your target CTL of 60 requires a disciplined progression rate (+1 to +2 CTL per week) adhering strictly to the 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 (Zone 2 Aerobic Base Run + Strides). Following nearly 4 weeks without structured volume, launching directly into hard VO2max intervals would carry an unsafe risk-to-reward ratio for connective tissue. Re-ignite your aerobic engine today, lay down foundational CTL, and prime neuromuscular pathways for upcoming quality blocks.

priority_1.session_title: Zone 2 Aerobic Base Run & Neuromuscular Strides
priority_1.workout_details: 10 min warm-up (Zone 1-2). 35 min steady Zone 2 run (HR strictly under 150 bpm). 4 x 15-second strides @ 90% speed effort with full walk recovery. 5 min cool-down.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely re-introduce running stress, build aerobic engine CTL towards your 60 CTL goal, and prime stride turnover without inducing excessive soreness.

priority_2.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up. 3 x 8 min @ 88-92% FTP (227-237 W) with 3 min Zone 1 spin recovery. 15 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total time: ~55 min.
priority_2.reason: Second priority to stimulate 20-minute threshold endurance and pedal stroke power while leveraging your cycling infrastructure with low impact.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 75kg. Barbell Bench Press: 3x8 @ 60kg. Heavy Sandbag Carry: 3x40m (70kg). KB Swings (20kg): 3x15. Core/Biceps circuit: 3 sets.
priority_3.reason: Third priority to develop cycling leg torque, structural resilience for running, and upper-body core aesthetics without imposing cardiorespiratory fatigue.
